business_summary: SBI Insurance Group Co., Ltd. provides various insurance products in Japan. It operates through Non-life Insurance Business, Life Insurance Business, and Small-amount Short-term Insurance Business segments. The Non-life Insurance Business segment offers automobile, cancer, and fire insurance. The Life Insurance Business segment provides group credit life insurance, group credit disability insurance, term insurance, disability insurance, and whole life medical insurance. The Small-amount Short-term Insurance Business segment offers medical, pet, motorcycle and bicycle, and earthquake insurance, as well as insurance for rental properties and tenants. SBI Insurance Group Co., Ltd. was founded in 2008 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan. SBI Insurance Group Co., Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of SBI Holdings, Inc.
business_summary_ko: SBI보험그룹주식회사는 일본에서 다양한 보험상품을 제공하고 있습니다. 손해보험사업, 생명보험사업, 소액단기보험사업 부문을 통해 운영됩니다. 손해보험 사업부문은 자동차보험, 암보험, 화재보험을 제공합니다. 생명보험사업부문은 단체신용생명보험, 단체신용장애보험, 정기보험, 장애보험, 종신의료보험을 제공합니다. 소액단기보험사업부문은 의료보험, 애완동물보험, 오토바이자전거보험, 지진보험, 임대주택 및 임차인 보험을 제공합니다. SBI Insurance Group Co., Ltd.는 2008년에 설립되었으며 일본 도쿄에 본사를 두고 있습니다. SBI보험그룹주식회사는 SBI Holdings, Inc.의 자회사로 운영됩니다.
